exposure: aortic root diameter < 40 mm vs 40-45 mm
cohort: 27 pregnancies in 20 women with Marfan Syndrome
finding: Vaginal delivery may be safe for women with Marfan Syndrome and an aortic root diameter ≤45 mm, and factors like family history of dissection and descending aorta size may be more important for predicting type B aortic dissection risk than previously thought.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery may be safely considered in women with Marfan Syndrome and an aortic root diameter ≤45 mm, provided rigorous pain control and avoidance of Valsalva maneuver.
